text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With victories in the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho,
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi conquered the Classic Triple Crown, shining as a Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The present I should give her is—

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Younger Siblings
text_block_list.text:
Yo, welcome back!
Tsu-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, everyone's here!
I'm back~!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, the younger brothers insisted on coming along to pick you up.
Dad is waiting in the car too.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You're so considerate, Trainer.
Saying 'You need private time with your family.'
...And going out of your way to arrange time off for us.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...That was incredible, Tsuyoshi.
Triple Crown Umamusume... congratulations."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Younger Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Tsu-chan,
how does it feel to be a Triple Crown Umamusume~?

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Younger Sister B
text_block_list.text: Let's give them a celebratory gold medal!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, I'm so happy~! Thank you~!
As for how it feels right now to be a Triple Crown Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Younger Brother A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't ask Tsuyoshi that kind of question.
She's already answered it a ton during TV interviews.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Why not~? If you younger brothers have questions too, ask away!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Younger Brother B
text_block_list.text:
I'm not listening~
Come on, little sisters, you're coming with me to help Mom.
Time to prep the sukiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? Then me too—

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. Tsu-chan is forbidden from doing chores this week. After all, you came here under the pretext of a 'vacation.'"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh... Whaaat~... !?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... I finally got to come home,
is it really okay for you to just laze around, Tsuyoshi...?

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. Triple Crown Umamusume
are always super busy anyway!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
After struggling and working so hard,
the least you can do is rest up while you're at home.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm gonna take a little nap, so there.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: Oh. Didn't resist.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "I mean... I understand why Mom and everyone else want me to rest."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I went and collapsed at both the Satsuki Sho and the Tokyo Yushun.
Giving everyone a scare each race.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, it's almost baffling how easily
they agreed to letting her run in the Kikuka Sho.
Apparently, as soon as it was reported, they said yes right away.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
...Because that's the responsibility of the one
who told them to 'have a good trip.'

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Responsibility?

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Yep. No matter how much I loved you,
no matter how precious you were to me.
Because I believed... that you could fly.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
I think having been the one to send her off in the first place,
she felt a responsibility to cheer for her until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Still, as parents, they must've really struggled.
...Things were tough for them behind the scenes, where Tsu-chan couldn't see.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Since we can't tell Tsu-chan directly,
Mom and Dad have been constantly on the phone
asking the Trainer for advice.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Every single time, though, she took it completely seriously.
She'd say she barely held back her legs from running off to help.
...I've heard it a million times already."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...So that's how it was.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Mother
text_block_list.text:
The sukiyaki's ready!
Everyone, grab your own chopsticks!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Younger Siblings
text_block_list.text:
Congrats on the Triple Crown, Tsu-chan!
Keep it up next year too, Tsuyoshi!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Thanks for cheering for me, everyone!
Seriously... thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Mother
text_block_list.text: Hey, Tsu-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Do you still want to run more?
Do you want to race to your heart's content?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I wanna run!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Right. Well then, starting next week
...be sure to keep doing your best, okay!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Yes!
